reason: The whole case requires unsupported error langlib operations: testMapAsRecord invokes x.detail() after parsing an invalid integer and asserts runtime membership of the resulting details in error:Detail and specific mapping/record types. lang.error supports only message, so this asserted behavior depends on excluded methods/types even though type-test expressions themselves are supported.
test_design_notes: io:println is output instrumentation and does not determine classification.

The case also contains readonly class Class, for which the module-level class qualifier support and object/class restriction conflict; the explicit error langlib exclusions independently suffice for feature classification.
